synthesis_chair.focus: Final rulings — accepts, overrides, Tom Kim adjudication

findings.topic: Negative links 6M signal vs elite NSI
findings.ruling: Scheffler holds T1 via elite NSI (100.0/100). 6M links SG: -0.161/rd (GSO near-miss performance). Links delta +3.7 VFS pts — modest negative. NSI dominance (40% weight) outweighs the links VFS penalty at this magnitude. T1 standing MAINTAINED. Note: Royal Birkdale links fragility is a real risk; if links-specific underperformance is systemic, market odds may be too short.

8 players in T1 (VTS≥78). All require NSI≥75 OR links delta≥4.0 to justify. T1 debuts (no Birkdale): 2 player(s) — these hold on NSI/VFS strength alone. Council accepts T1 list as structurally sound. No forced demotions.

RULING: Tom Kim moves from v2 rank ~50 to v3 rank 44 (T3). No manual override applied — model movement (10.9 VTS pts gained) is evidence-based. Links SG signal is sustained across multiple windows (not just GSO). Top 10 and Top 20 markets are the recommended play. Win market: plausible ceiling but NSI constraint at 58.7/100 limits structural T1 case.

6m.note: GSO win — sole 6M event, high conf penalty

tom_kim_adjudication.architect_ruling: Tom Kim's general L12 SG (0.530/rd) placed him ~50th in v2. Links SG across all windows is elite: 6M +4.168 (1 ev, conf=0.40), 12M +2.977 (2 ev, conf=0.75), 24M +1.924 (4 ev), alltime +2.095 (8 ev). Weighted signal +1.959/rd → VFS delta +7.8 pts applied. NSI remains constrained by general form (0.530/rd → pctile 58.7). VTS v3: 60.9 (v2 was ~50). Material upward movement confirmed.
tom_kim_adjudication.skeptic_challenge: 6M window is GSO win only (1 event, conf=0.40). GSO at Dundonald Links — a legitimate links test but single-tournament sample. If GSO was a one-week form spike on a moderately links-like layout, alltime 8-event signal (+2.095/rd) provides the stabiliser. NSI constraint at 58.7/100 limits T2 case — links ceiling is real but general skill floor is mid-field.
tom_kim_adjudication.market_contrarian_note: Post-GSO win, market may overrate Tom Kim's general form but underrate his links-specific ceiling. VTS 60.9 (T3) represents a structural re-rating from v2 ~50th. At correct links-adjusted odds, Tom Kim is a value play in Top 20 and Top 10 markets. Win market remains constrained by NSI floor vs T1 players.
